heading: About the IELC
paragraphs: The Indian Evangelical Lutheran Church (IELC) is a confessional Lutheran Church denomination based in Nagercoil, Tamil Nadu, South India. For administrative purposes, the IELC is divided into three Synods — the Ambur Synod, the Nagercoil Synod, and the Trivandrum Synod.

The IELC was founded as a result of missionary work done in India by the Lutheran Church–Missouri Synod (LC-MS) in the United States. It was officially registered under the Company Registration Act of 1860, under its present name.

The core of the IELC's mission is the Concordia Theological Seminary in Nagercoil, established in 1924 to train pastors for the Tamil- and Malayalam-speaking congregations. From October 2025, the IELC is headed by its President, Rev. Dr. M. Mohanan.
